purposes.api-contract-compatibility-check: Verify request, response, error and version compatibility for the selected API producer and its supported consumers.
purposes.notification-content-audit: Find misleading, missing or wrongly localized notification content at the actual event, audience and channel boundary.
purposes.notification-content-polish: Correct notification wording, variables and action links while preserving event meaning, audience and channel constraints.
purposes.seo-geo-audit: Inspect crawlability, indexing, canonical and language signals, structured data and evidence-backed page content for search and answer engines.
purposes.seo-geo-polish: Repair demonstrated crawl, indexing, canonical, localization or structured-data defects and improve supported page answers without inventing ranking results.
purposes.design-gen: Document the current system design, ownership boundaries and important decisions from repository evidence in the requested artifact.
purposes.readme-gen: Write or update a README with verified setup, usage and project boundaries for its intended reader.
purposes.oauth-oidc-session-check: Verify OAuth/OIDC redirects, tokens and session lifecycle at the supported provider and trusted identity boundary.
purposes.mcp-protocol-auth-check: Verify MCP discovery, schemas, real transport, errors and authorization for the selected server and supported clients.
purposes.deploy-bootstrap: Prepare deployment configuration and verification for the selected existing runtime and provider; preparation does not execute a deployment.
purposes.incident-recovery-check: Verify incident mitigation and recovery against the affected artifact, cohort, operation and observed recovery window.
purposes.instant-architecture-probe: Inspect one unvisited architecture path for a demonstrated owner or contract defect and repair it only when authorized.
purposes.instant-backend-probe: Trace one backend operation for a reachable defect, verify its durable effects and repair it only when authorized.
purposes.instant-bug-fix-polish: Find and, when authorized, fix one demonstrated bug at its defining owner, then verify the failure and a valid control.
purposes.instant-frontend-probe: Inspect one frontend state or interaction for a real user-visible defect and repair it only when authorized.
purposes.instant-ui-ux-visual-probe: Render and inspect one interface state for a demonstrated visual or interaction defect, with before/after evidence for an authorized repair.
purposes.release-artifact-trust-check: Verify final release bytes, expected digest, signature or provenance and the trusted build/publication identity.
purposes.patch-checking: Review the complete resulting patch against intended behavior and its original comparison base; repeat after authorized corrections until clean or blocked.
purposes.serverless-invocation-check: Verify required and deferred work, response lifetime, retries and effects on the actual serverless adapter/runtime boundary.
purposes.evolution-improvement: Prioritize evidence-backed improvement opportunities with an expected outcome, tradeoffs and an actionable next decision.
purposes.iteration-closure: Assess the selected iteration against acceptance evidence and return done, next slice, replan or blocked.
purposes.map-synthesis: Reconcile repository maps against current source owners while preserving stable IDs and exposing conflicting or stale claims.
purposes.synthesis: Consolidate overlapping findings into distinct corrections with acceptance evidence, dependencies and unresolved decisions.
purposes.task-shaping: Turn a requested outcome into an executable brief with scope, owner, acceptance, dependencies and a verification plan.
purposes.validation-clarification: Validate whether a brief is ready to execute; resolve available facts and expose only decisions or evidence that actually block it.
purposes.web-boundary-check: Verify server HTML, hydration, navigation, serialized data, trusted server actions and directly affected caches in the actual framework.
purposes.behavior-check: Verify the selected behavior using explicit criteria, a distinguishing failing case, a valid control and observable results.
purposes.map-refresh-polish: Correct proven stale map entries against current sources while preserving useful structure and stable IDs.
purposes.map-staleness-check: Compare selected map entries with current source owners and classify their freshness with evidence.
purposes.prompt-skill-sync-audit: Inspect this plugin for drift between prompt intent, skill triggers, workflow transitions, retrieval contracts and packaged content.
purposes.prompt-skill-sync-polish: Repair demonstrated prompt, skill, composition or retrieval drift while preserving useful domain instructions and stable identities.
purposes.scoped-audit: Find concrete defects in a selected behavior when no more specific domain workflow fits; hand off its owner, failure and acceptance check.
purposes.scoped-polish: Implement a selected, already-authorized correction at its owning boundary and synchronize directly affected contracts.
purposes.web-offer-synthesis: Synthesize a real offer, audience, proof and conversion contract before planning an original homepage or landing page.
purposes.web-page-architecture: Choose and order meaningful page sections, functional modules and conversion paths from the actual offer and visitor questions.
purposes.web-page-copy: Write exact professional page copy and concise action/error/state strings with truthful claims and correct locale grammar.
purposes.web-reference-research: Inspect relevant references and real assets, extract adaptable design mechanisms and record source/status and production needs.
purposes.web-art-direction: Define an original project-specific visual concept, opening, section compositions, rhythm, transitions and material/graphic language.
purposes.web-brand-assets: Create or preserve a coherent logo family, optical small mark, favicon/browser/touch/sharing assets and verified export manifest.
purposes.web-visual-system: Specify concrete type, semantic colors, grid, components, surfaces/elevation, borders and responsive/material rules from the chosen direction.
purposes.web-design-kit: Compile chosen parameters into local CSS tokens, procedural SVG/materials, a visual review board and explicit numeric validation evidence.
purposes.web-interaction-storyboard: Specify triggers, states, useful feedback, timing, recovery, responsive variants and static/reduced-motion fallbacks for selected page modules.
purposes.web-project-architecture: Choose a supported efficient stack, modular workspace/import boundaries, rendering/content/integration owners and measurable delivery budgets.
purposes.web-experience-brief: Consolidate actual strategy, copy, assets, design and architecture decisions into a coherent build packet and reconcile every required outcome.
purposes.homepage-landing-build: Build a complete new homepage or landing experience from its real brief, with modular components, useful interactions and evidenced acceptance.
purposes.homepage-landing-audit: Inspect a rendered existing page and reachable states for evidenced visual, content, navigation, conversion and loading defects without editing.
purposes.homepage-landing-polish: Finish a partial site, correct its supported defects or implement an authorized redesign while preserving required working content, routes and effects.
purposes.web-visual-hierarchy-check: Verify actual page/component hierarchy, optical alignment, spacing, typography and material accents across relevant rendered states and viewports.
purposes.web-navigation-state-check: Traverse meaningful navigation and control state/effect/recovery paths; valid IDs alone cannot close empty or misleading destinations.
purposes.web-interaction-motion-check: Verify selected modules, actual timing/effects, accessible and reduced-motion/static controls, material states and bounded resource lifecycle.
purposes.web-search-performance-check: Check real route/head/crawler/provider readiness and measured loading budgets, separating local proof from indexing, citations and field performance.
purposes.web-page-acceptance-check: Reconcile the complete actual page with required outcomes and domain evidence; omitted assets, unavailable actions and unverified gates remain open.
